# FiiViu

> FiiViu is a Bucharest, Romania platform for discovering and booking local experiences, activities, wellness, nightlife, VIP moments, and Secret Menüs.

## Website

- Homepage: https://fiiviu.ro/
- Sitemap: https://fiiviu.ro/sitemap.xml
- Public experience catalog: https://fiiviu.ro/api/offers

## Main categories

- Explore / Bukarest entdecken: https://fiiviu.ro/?category=explore
- Relax / Wellness: https://fiiviu.ro/?category=relax
- Nightlife: https://fiiviu.ro/?category=nightlife
- Adventure: https://fiiviu.ro/?category=adventure
- VIP: https://fiiviu.ro/?category=vip
- Secret Menüs: https://fiiviu.ro/?category=secret-menus

## Languages

The website supports German, English, and Romanian.

- German: https://fiiviu.ro/?lang=de
- English: https://fiiviu.ro/?lang=en
- Romanian: https://fiiviu.ro/?lang=ro

## About FiiViu

FiiViu focuses on bookable moments in and around Bucharest. The catalog can include guided city experiences, cycling, wellness and spa experiences, nightlife, adventure activities, VIP experiences, and fixed-price Secret Menüs at selected restaurants.

## Data and freshness

Public experience data is served from the live catalog endpoint at https://fiiviu.ro/api/offers. Availability, prices, descriptions, meeting points, and provider information can change and should be checked against the live website before presenting them as current.

## Crawling

Public pages are intended to be crawlable. OAI-SearchBot, OAI-AdsBot, GPTBot, Googlebot, and other general web crawlers are explicitly allowed by robots.txt.
